caption:
Your player card takes a minute: your area, your position, your level. Save it and see the clubs looking for players like you. 🟢

The Cancha app is coming to the App Store. Join the waitlist: link in bio. 📲

App preview: the screens are illustrations of the upcoming app. Club crests shown with each club's okay.

altText: Cancha app preview on a phone: an account is created, a player card fills in tap by tap (area, position, level, age, experience), the finished lime player card lifts out, and clubs looking for a midfielder slide in.
